texts.zh:
清晰的证据表明，在过去的某个时点曾有一个智慧物种居住在[From.Planet.GetName]。我们发现了即将开始进行亚光速宇宙航行的工业文明的遗迹。

然而，在某一时刻，这个文明遭到了一场席卷全球的灾难的袭击并被彻底摧毁。目前剩下的只有废墟，且没有迹象表明受灾民众采取了任何防护措施。整个事件既不暴力也没有破坏性，一切似乎都单纯是……停止了。不管他们曾受到什么打击，都应该完全出乎意料……又或许，他们选择了不去抵抗。
texts.en:
There is clear evidence that [From.Planet.GetName] was at some point inhabited by a sapient species. Ruins that have been found of an industrial age civilization on the cusp of pre-FTL spaceflight.

At some point, however, this civilization was struck with a planet-wide calamity and totally extinguished. Little more than rubble remains, and there are no signs that any protective measures were taken by the afflicted population. The event was not violent or destructive, everything just seemed to... stop. Whatever hit them came as a complete surprise... or, perhaps, they chose not to resist it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在最大的城市的废墟下，我们有了惊人的发现。探地传感器探测到地下有着大规模的人工构造。其入口设计精妙，或许是用于举办某种仪式。但进一步的探索很快便宣告暂停。

[From.Planet.GetName]的两颗卫星引力非常大，以至于影响到了星球地核中的岩浆流动。该地下建筑群便利用了这一点，使其走廊及各房间内周期性地涌入岩浆。幸运的是，岩浆涨落的节律是可以预测的。但为什么一个相对先进的文明要在地下建造一座死亡陷阱依然是一个谜。
texts.en:
Beneath the ruins of the largest city, an amazing discovery was made! An artificial underground complex of immense proportions was detected by surface-penetrating sensors. The entrance, highly elaborate in design and possibly ceremonial in nature, was easily located, but further exploration was quickly halted.

The two large moons of [From.Planet.GetName] exert exceptionally powerful tidal forces, so strong in fact that they affect the motion of magma currents in the planet's core. The underground complex seems to be built with this in mind, with the corridors and chambers periodically flooded with running lava. Luckily enough the ebb and flow can be predicted, but it is as yet a mystery why a relatively advanced civilization would construct a subterranean deathtrap like this.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
一支探险队被派入火山隧道网络。在岩浆冲刷的玄武岩迷宫中确定方向将是一项棘手的任务，因为岩浆的频繁周期性涨落地会使探险队不时陷入困境。就算探险队最后真的到达了迷宫的尽头，回头路同样十分漫长。

一旦进入迷宫，就没有办法与探险队通讯。我们只能等待。
texts.en:
An expedition was sent down into the volcanic tunnel network. Navigating the magma-scoured basalt maze will be a delicate business, as the frequent ebb and flow of lava periodically maroons the expedition deep within. When - or if - the end of the labyrinth is reached, there is also the long road back that needs to be traversed.

Once inside, there is no way of communicating with the expedition. We can only wait.

texts.zh:
熔岩迷宫探险队终于回来了，大多毫发无损，注意是“大多”。经过岩浆河，在迷宫的中心，探险队发现了一间隐蔽的密室。此密室为阻挡周围的热量而建造，内有数千卷教会性质的卷轴。它们十分古老，可能是土著信仰体系的基础文本。

这种宗教是曾经居住在这个世界上的几个民族-语言群体的本土信仰的融合。他们在一件事上是一致的：大敌，吞噬一切的阴影，即某种深不可测的恶质宇宙公敌，总有一天会到来。最好在它到来前死去，以免灵魂被其夺走。

这个世界的居民显然是基于这种信仰而集体自杀的。
texts.en:
The lava labyrinth expedition has finally returned, mostly unscathed. Mostly. Past the rivers of magma, at the heart of the labyrinth, the inner sanctum was discovered. Built to keep out the surrounding heat, the chamber contained thousands of scrolls of ecclesiastical nature. They were ancient, and could potentially be the foundational texts of the indigenous belief system.

This religion was a syncretic hybrid of the native beliefs of several ethno-linguistic groups that once inhabited this world. They are all are unanimous in one thing: the Archenemy, the Shadow that Devours All, some cosmic foe of unfathomable malice, will arrive on a certain date, and it would be better to not be alive when it does, lest one's soul be taken.

The inhabitants of the world apparently committed mass suicide based on this belief.

texts.zh:
探险队终于从深处现身了——而且不是空手而归！在最里面的房间里探险队取得了惊人的发现：一个真正的宝库！满是贵重金属、宝石、小饰品和令人惊叹的艺术品，很容易理解这样的宝藏值得如此深藏不露。

安全地取回这些宝藏将是一项耗时的任务，但并非难以应付。然而，为什么要在如此极端的环境下建造宝库的问题依旧：这仅仅是一个古怪收藏家的藏品保险库吗？又或是某种形式的宗教祭祀？还是这个古老的文明把他们的宝藏埋在这里，希望有一天有人会知道他们的故事？
texts.en:
The expedition has finally emerged from the deep - and not empty-handed! In the innermost chamber a surprising discovery was made: an actual treasure vault! Crammed with precious metals and gemstones, trinkets and stunning artwork, it's easy to understand how a treasure trove like this warranted such profound protection.

Safely recovering this hoard will be a time-consuming task, but not an insurmountable one. The question as to why the vault was constructed in such an extreme environment remains, however: was it just acquisitions security of an eccentric collector? Could it be some form of ritual sacrifice? Or did this ancient civilization bury their treasures here in hopes that some day, someone would know their story?

texts.zh:
熔岩迷宫探险队终于回来了！到达最里面的房间后，我们终于明白这些宏伟的建筑物所用为何。迷宫是一座试炼场，与其说试验身体，更多的是考验心灵。

在最深处的内室里，有一段用当地语言反复涂写的短语。翻译为：“……潮汐的444444次转向将是最后一次。没有什么能抵挡它的重生。”不管这是什么意思，似乎很少有朝圣的幸存者在阅读完这段文本后选择返回地面，他们转而投身于火海之中。
texts.en:
The lava labyrinth expedition has finally returned! Having reached the innermost chamber, the purpose of the magnificent complex was finally revealed. The labyrinth served as a proving ground, not for the body as much as the mind.

There is a phrase in the native language scrawled repeatedly in the inner sanctum. Translation reads: "...the 4,444,444th turn of the tides will be the Last. Nothing will withstand Its rebirth." Whatever that means, it seems that few of those who survived this deadly pilgrimage chose to return to the surface after reading it, instead giving themselves to the rivers of fire.

summary.text:
# 岩石之外 / Any Other Rock

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:852；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:3554 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重100，只出现在熔岩星球上。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 100 on molten worlds.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一颗死寂的熔岩星球上曾有接近太空时代的文明；城市下方的熔岩迷宫通往一座内殿，结局随机揭示内殿的用途。

1. 已逝之人：工业时代文明的废墟，文明在灾变中消亡
2. 死亡迷宫：最大城市下方的巨型人工地下迷宫
3. 熔岩地板：考察队进入随熔岩涨落的火山隧道

A lifeless molten world once held a civilisation on the edge of spaceflight; a lava labyrinth beneath its largest city leads to an inner sanctum whose purpose is revealed by a random ending.

1. Certainly Gone Now: ruins of an industrial civilisation struck down by a catastrophe
2. Labyrinth of Death: a vast artificial labyrinth under the largest city
3. The Floor is Lava: an expedition enters the volcanic tunnels as the lava ebbs and flows

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 宗教文本 / Sacred Texts：内殿保存成千上万卷宗教经卷（按帝国类型获得不同的永久修正） / the sanctum holds thousands of scriptures (a permanent modifier depending on empire type)
- 珍宝藏库 / Treasure Trove：真正的宝库：稀有水晶、异域气体、不稳定微粒各200 / a real treasure vault: 200 each of rare crystals, exotic gases and volatile motes
- 囹圄之静 / Serenity in Isolation：迷宫是磨炼心志的试炼场 / the labyrinth was a proving ground for the mind

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用本遗址专属的事件池 site_ebb_and_flow_random_events。 / Failed rolls draw from this site's own pool site_ebb_and_flow_random_events.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：遗址定义（common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:852）的阶段顺序与条件、各阶段事件脚本、出现方式；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the site definition (common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:852) with its stage order and conditions, every stage event script, and how the site appears; both languages read.
- 结构修正：最后一个阶段事件 ancrel.9176 是隐藏的随机分派，草稿把它的几个互斥结局错排成连续阶段；现改为最后可见阶段之后的互斥分支。
- Structural fix: the last stage event ancrel.9176 is a hidden random dispatcher; the draft chained its exclusive endings as consecutive stages. They are now exclusive branches after the last visible stage.
